transformations.rainfall_72h: sum of D, D-1, D-2; missing any day → null
transformations.rainfall_7d: sum of D through D-6; missing any day → null
transformations.rainfall_14d: sum of D through D-13; missing any day → null
transformations.rainfall_prev_72h: sum of D-1, D-2, D-3 (excludes D)
transformations.rainfall_prev_7d: sum of D-1 through D-7 (excludes D)
transformations.rainfall_prev_14d: sum of D-1 through D-14 (excludes D)

baselines.descriptive_median: Median of all daily precip for location × calendar month in this extract. Uses later years. Descriptive only — not leakage-safe for backtesting an event in-sample.
baselines.past_only_median: Median of daily precip for the same location × calendar month in years strictly before the row year; requires ≥3 prior years.
baselines.past_only_percentile: Share of prior same-month daily values ≤ current day's precip

malaria_climate_comparison.coordinate_note: Malaria climate uses district centroids. Flood-zone rows use catalog lat/lng and are not expected to match centroid monthly totals. Comparison uses district_centroid rows only.

flood_event_join.join: event location → weather location_id; event_start T → weather date T

limitations: 23 flood zones do not represent all flood-prone communities in Sierra Leone.
District centroids are fallback geography, not catchment pour points.
Weather is not flood ground truth.
Archive reanalysis is not a rain-gauge observation.
soil_moisture_0_to_10cm was requested in a probe but returned undefined units and was dropped.
15 catalog locations have no daily series in this extract (Open-Meteo Archive rate-limit/500 during ingest).
disclaimer: Historical weather data does not constitute historical flood-event ground truth.

outputs.note: training_sets/*.json is gitignored; diagnostics copy is the reviewable manifest.
